fieldValues.title: Standing rules stand alone
fieldValues.article_text: A rule that will apply next time gets its own record. Once it exists, ask whether the one-off decision beneath it still needs asking. Checked by: judgement.
fieldValues.rationale: The owner's meeting review found that once a standing rule was split out, the one-off decision beneath it was no longer the committee's to make. srs#998 has the same shape: 'an id travels beside its label in the same output'.
